rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Multi-Gmail provides 15 MCP tools for managing multiple Gmail accounts simultaneously through OAuth2 authentication. It supports account management, inbox search using Gmail syntax, full email retrieval, sending and replying to emails, draft creation, label management, archiving, and read status control. Credentials are stored securely in SQLite in the user's home directory with limited OAuth scopes.
